limitations: Linux tests use real Linux userspace on Linux hosts with Mesa software graphics and Xvfb; they do not exercise physical V4L cameras, camera firmware/driver behavior, hardware GPU rendering or a Wayland session.
GREY format and captured bytesused regressions are native Linux unit tests. Physical fast-spin, motion-blur and camera disconnection behavior still require device testing.
The bundled 300-frame reference fixture and synthetic suites constrain these measured cases; this report makes no general scientific parity or future hardware compatibility guarantee.
Release assets were read while the release was a draft; publication and official macOS package audits are managed separately.
